person.name: Hussain Abuwala
person.title: Software Developer
person.intro: I work on LLM-powered analytics in IBM watsonx BI. I’m curious about software in general, and I share what I build and learn on The Unplanned Stack.
person.resume_summary: Software developer with 3+ years of experience building AI-powered analytics products, backend services, and cloud-native applications at IBM. Progressed from Band 6 to Band 7 and delivered LLM-based systems that cut processing costs by 99.8%, improved performance 6.5x, and generated $19K in monthly customer savings.

items.title: Metadata enrichment v2
items.summary: Cut cost per asset from $5.32 to $0.009 by rebuilding watsonx BI metadata enrichment as a native LLM pipeline that replaced external dependencies. 6.5× faster, accuracy above 90%, and $19K in monthly customer savings.
items.resume: Rebuilt IBM watsonx BI metadata enrichment (v2) as a native LLM pipeline, cutting per-asset cost 99.8% ($5.32 to $0.009), delivering $19K in monthly customer savings, maintaining 90%+ accuracy, and improving performance 6.5x.

items.title: Data Stories
items.summary: An analytics agent that finds two or three verifiable findings in a dataset without the user asking a question. Selected for executive review.
items.resume: Developed Data Stories, an autonomous analytics agent that surfaced 2-3 decision-grade, verifiable findings from a dataset without requiring users to formulate questions; selected for executive review.

items.title: Custom Instructions
items.summary: Lets business users write domain rules in plain language. The rules feed asset discovery and SQL generation, so answers follow each customer’s business context.
items.resume: Implemented Custom Instructions, enabling business users to encode domain rules and knowledge in natural language; integrated the instructions into asset discovery and SQL generation to produce answers grounded in each customer's business context.

items.title: Visualization editor
items.summary: A chart editor for IBM watsonx.data with manual authoring and automatic chart recommendations, using metadata enrichment, aggregation selection, semantic sorting and type inference.
items.resume: Built a visualization editor for IBM watsonx.data with manual authoring and automatic chart recommendations based on metadata enrichment, aggregation selection, semantic sorting, and numerical, categorical, and identifier type inference.

items.title: Number formatting
items.summary: Currency, percentage and number formatting across text answers and charts, which unblocked a prospective customer.
items.resume: Delivered currency, percentage, and number formatting across textual answers and visualizations, removing a critical adoption blocker for a prospective customer.

items.title: Metadata enrichment v1
items.summary: Cut glossary uploads from about 20 minutes to under 3 by modernizing the legacy enrichment service and integrating watsonx.data intelligence classification. It powers five services: conversational analytics, visualization, insights, semantic search and Suggested Questions.
items.resume: Modernized a legacy metadata enrichment service (v1) and integrated watsonx.data intelligence classification, reducing glossary-artifact upload time from approximately 20 minutes to under 3 minutes; powered five core services spanning conversational analytics, visualization, insights, semantic search, and Suggested Questions.

items.title: Suggested Questions
items.summary: An LLM service that generates and pre-validates answerable questions from enriched schemas, giving users a guided first interaction. Won an IBM Outstanding Innovation Award.
items.resume: Built an LLM-powered Suggested Questions service that used enriched schemas to generate and pre-validate answerable analytical questions, creating a guided first interaction for users; recognized with an IBM Outstanding Innovation Award.

projects.title: URL Shortener
projects.summary: Load-tested through nine scripted events up to 10% of Bitly’s traffic, changing the design only when an event broke it. Final version: about 877M redirects a month at 14.8 ms p99 with 0% errors, for €9.56 a month.
projects.resume: Built a URL shortener on a single server and load-tested it with k6 through nine scripted events up to 10% of Bitly's traffic (1,000 redirects/s); final design serves an estimated 877M redirects/month at 14.8 ms p99 with 0% errors for EUR 9.56/month, and recovers from machine loss in under 6 minutes.

projects.title: LLM from scratch
projects.summary: A language model built step by step, from a table of counts to a small Transformer. Each episode has a notebook, tests, and two videos. 3 of 14 episodes published.
projects.resume: Building a character-level language model from scratch in a 14-episode video series (Python, NumPy, later PyTorch), from count-based n-grams to a decoder-only Transformer; each episode ships tested code and notebooks.

thoughts.title: Everything Has a Price
thoughts.summary: An animated essay about desire and what it costs. 2 min 44 s.
